whyMatters.en: Chicago alternative band; Siamese Dream (1993) and Mellon Collie (1995) stacked wall-of-guitar production with dream-pop and metal dynamics.
whyMatters.zh: 芝加哥 alternative；Siamese Dream（1993）与 Mellon Collie（1995）把墙式吉他制作叠上 dream-pop 与金属动态。

shortBio.en: Billy Corgan–led alt-rock; 1979 is the mid-90s melodic single.
shortBio.zh: Billy Corgan 领衔的 alt-rock；1979 是 90 年代中期旋律单曲。

body.en:
Formed 1988. Gish and Siamese Dream (Butch Vig) established Corgan’s layered guitars, Chamberlin/Wretzky rhythm section, and loud-quiet pivots; Mellon Collie expanded to double-album scope.

1979 (1996) shows the electronic-tinged, mid-tempo side. They occupy 1990s alt radio beside Nirvana/Pearl Jam with more prog ambition and studio maximalism.
body.zh:
1988 年组建。Gish 与 Siamese Dream（Butch Vig）确立 Corgan 多层吉他、Chamberlin/Wretzky 节奏组与强弱转折；Mellon Collie 扩到双专体量。

1979（1996）展示偏电子的中速面。与 Nirvana/Pearl Jam 同在 1990 年代 alt 电台，prog 野心与录音室最大化更强。
